classification.scope: Repository-only Tushare retained response and canonical provider-row binding.

implemented_contract: A retained financial response returns its decoded payload and exact typed artifact reference as one immutable value.
Unified relay, REST path and routed SDK financial modes preserve that reference on the dataframe-compatible result.
Tushare facts bind the retained body SHA-256, native asset, native fiscal period and a bounded canonical provider-row coordinate.
The coordinate is derived from ts_code/end_date/ann_date/metric and is not claimed to be a provider-issued opaque identifier.
Date-only ann_date does not populate announced_at or available_at.
Strict sync blocks before bulk_upsert when trustworthy source time remains absent.

tdd_red.detail: The handler discarded the retention reference and adapter facts lacked source/decision evidence.

focused_tests.execution: split runs; includes the 302.13-second Django repository candidate case

hash_scope.source_sha256: Git index blobs with repository line-ending normalization.
hash_scope.source_worktree_raw_sha256: Raw local worktree bytes at evidence generation.
hash_scope.raw_summary_sha256: Raw UTF-8 summary bytes at evidence generation.

independent_review.implementation_result: P0=0 and P1=0 after direct three-mode retained-envelope coverage.
accepted_boundaries: All three routed clients preserve the same retained reference.
The canonical coordinate is truthful and bounded.
Date-only ann_date does not infer source time.
Strict sync remains fail-closed with zero normalized writes.
independent_review.evidence_finding_resolution: The referenced JSON, TXT and JSON SHA-256 files are generated and checked in this change.

governance.reason: Retained body and canonical row binding are implemented; trustworthy source time and production authorization remain open.

remaining_gates: Obtain a trustworthy timezone-aware announcement or availability source without synthesizing time.
Provide equivalent retained artifact and row binding for any other financial provider selected for production.
Obtain current production authority, owner-approved numeric tolerances and explicit production-write authorization.
Run the authorized provider backfill and real four-Publication reconciliation.
